tasks.label: Deploy Agent to Phone
tasks.command: adb -s VGPB8LFANZNBVOHQ install -r android\app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk; adb -s VGPB8LFANZNBVOHQ shell am force-stop com.mobiflux.agent; adb -s VGPB8LFANZNBVOHQ shell am start -n com.mobiflux.agent/.MainActivity

tasks.label: Check Agent Status
tasks.command: adb -s VGPB8LFANZNBVOHQ forward tcp:18081 tcp:18081; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500; Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:18081/agent/status" -UseBasicParsing | ConvertTo-Json

tasks.label: Run Discovery and List Devices
tasks.command: Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:5080/api/v1/mobiflux/device-discovery-runs" -Method Post | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:5080/api/v1/mobiflux/devices" | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5

tasks.label: Test Proxy Endpoints
tasks.command: $proxies = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:5080/api/v1/mobiflux/proxies"; $proxies | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5; foreach ($p in $proxies.data) { Write-Host "Testing proxy: $($p.id) on port $($p.port)..."; try { $res = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:5080/api/v1/mobiflux/proxies/$($p.id)/test" -Method Post; $res | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 } catch { Write-Host "Error: $_" } }

tasks.label: Check MobiFlux Processes 2
tasks.command: Get-Process -Name MobiFlux* -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id, ProcessName

tasks.label: Check MobiFlux Service Command Line
tasks.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name LIKE 'MobiFlux%'" | Select-Object ProcessId, Name, CommandLine

tasks.label: Get MobiFlux Process Path
tasks.command: Get-Process -Name MobiFlux* | Select-Object Id, ProcessName, Path

tasks.label: Get Local IP
tasks.command: Get-NetIPAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 | Where-Object { $_.InterfaceAlias -notlike "*Loopback*" -and $_.IPAddress -notlike "169.254*" } | Select-Object IPAddress, InterfaceAlias

tasks.label: Get 400 Error Body
tasks.command: try { $body = '{"name":"Proxy-LAN-HTTP","bindAddress":"0.0.0.0","port":8080,"protocol":"HttpConnect","deviceId":"fdcccbde-a5bb-4930-aefa-66030ab47886"}'; Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:5080/api/v1/mobiflux/proxies" -Method Post -Body $body -ContentType "application/json" } catch { $_.Exception.Response.GetResponseStream() | ForEach-Object { (New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($_)).ReadToEnd() } }

tasks.label: Create LAN Proxy Correct JSON
tasks.command: $obj = @{ name = 'Proxy-LAN-HTTP'; bindAddress = '0.0.0.0'; port = 8080; protocol = 'HttpConnect'; deviceId = 'fdcccbde-a5bb-4930-aefa-66030ab47886' }; Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:5080/api/v1/mobiflux/proxies" -Method Post -Body ($obj | ConvertTo-Json) -ContentType "application/json" | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5

tasks.label: Get 400 Error Body 2
tasks.command: try { $obj = @{ name = 'Proxy-LAN-HTTP'; bindAddress = '0.0.0.0'; port = 8080; protocol = 'HttpConnect'; deviceId = 'fdcccbde-a5bb-4930-aefa-66030ab47886' }; Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:5080/api/v1/mobiflux/proxies" -Method Post -Body ($obj | ConvertTo-Json) -ContentType "application/json" } catch { $_.Exception.Response.GetResponseStream() | ForEach-Object { (New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($_)).ReadToEnd() } }

tasks.label: Check StartTime
tasks.command: Get-Process -Name MobiFlux* | Select-Object Id, ProcessName, StartTime

tasks.label: Rebuild With Processes Stopped
tasks.command: Stop-Process -Name MobiFlux* -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; dotnet build

tasks.label: Create LAN Proxy Now
tasks.command: $obj = @{ name = 'Proxy-LAN-HTTP'; bindAddress = '0.0.0.0'; port = 8080; protocol = 'HttpConnect'; deviceId = 'fdcccbde-a5bb-4930-aefa-66030ab47886' }; Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:5080/api/v1/mobiflux/proxies" -Method Post -Body ($obj | ConvertTo-Json) -ContentType "application/json" | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5

tasks.label: Allow Port 8080 Inbound
tasks.command: netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name="MobiFlux LAN 8080" dir=in action=allow protocol=TCP localport=8080

tasks.label: Allow MobiFlux Service Inbound
tasks.command: New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName 'MobiFlux Service' -Direction Inbound -Program 'C:\Users\hoaug\Desktop\MobiFlux\src\MobiFlux.Service\bin\Debug\net10.0\MobiFlux.Service.exe' -Action Allow -Profile Any -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

tasks.label: Check Existing Rules
tasks.command: Get-NetFirewallRule | Where-Object { $_.DisplayName -like "*MobiFlux*" -or $_.DisplayName -like "*net10*" } | Select-Object DisplayName, Direction, Action
